$comment: #EXP-2109 (owner 2026-11-25), #EXP-2168 (owner 2026-11-26: ONE header concept on EVERY page, detail pages included) THE HEADER: ONE rule for every page's header ×5 (iOS, Android, web-mobile, web md+, the desktop IDE), top-level and detail alike (issue, chat/session, agent, app, device, call view, settings subpages, repo, CI run, the find bar replacing a chat's header). LEFT: the back control (a pushed page) or the close control (a bar that replaces the header) = THE ROUND ICON BUTTON too (`leading`: concept per control), then the leading glyph, the title, LEFT-aligned, never centred. RIGHT: `order`, headerActions(page): status (what the page reports: the waiting chips, the issue graph), primary (the page's ONE labelled verb: Create, Publish, Start, the Merge pill; the only text a header holds), call, page (the page's own icon: the inbox's mark read, a device's settings, the find bar's previous / next), search, inbox, add, more; a page lists only what it has (`pages`, phone and wide; null = the page has no header there). Every control but status and primary is THE ROUND ICON BUTTON, one look everywhere: `circle` px on phones (the filled circle: web `HeaderAction`, Android `PageHeaderCircle`, iOS `HeaderCircleButton`), `wideCircle` px on web md+ and the IDE (the same filled circle, desktop `header_button`); the glyph `glyph` / `wideGlyph`; never a ghost glyph, never a hand-rolled circle. ADD = concept `icons.add`, always its OWN button, never an entry of the `…`; it runs the page's one create verb at once (`adds`), or opens the create menu where there are several. MORE = concept `icons.more`, always LAST, only secondary verbs: headerMenu(entries) = the page's menu without `menuDrops` (what the + does, Open on the page itself, Move to folder: the tree's), separators tidied; an empty one = no button. ROWS that carry the pair (a team's row in the tree, `rows`) wear the same + then …. A row's long-press / right-click keeps its WHOLE menu (sidebar-menus.json). A settings list's own New pill in its section band is not a header. GUARD (`guard`, replayed by apps/web `header-guard.test.ts` over every client's sources on every PR): per client the shared round control (`round`) and the header hosts (`hosts`); no host's call may hold a `banned` control, and the `gone` names (the old ghost / hand-rolled header buttons) exist nowhere. COLLAPSE (#EXP-2183, coordinator 2026-11-26): on a narrow (phone) bar the TITLE keeps at least `collapse.titleMinShare` of the bar (or its whole intrinsic width when shorter): headerCollapse({bar, title, fixed, chips}) folds the trailing chips in `collapse.order` until it does, the Merge pill (`primary`: "Checks running", "Needs approval") first, then the waiting chip (`status`, `? 2`) if still needed. A folded chip = THE SAME pill / strip chip showing only its glyph: its tone colour kept, its count / label gone from sight but kept as the accessibility label (the full text); its tap unchanged. `bar` = the header row's width, `title` = the title's intrinsic width, `fixed` = everything that never folds (back, disc, call, +, …, gaps, padding), each chip `full` / `compact` its two widths; the result lists the folded actions in fold order (`collapseCases`). Phones only (iOS, Android, web-mobile); web md+ and the IDE never fold (their bar is wide), the IDE twin replays the cases all the same.

collapseCases.name: a phone chat, `? 2` + Checks running, a long title: both fold
a medium title: the Merge pill alone folds
a short title that fits: nothing folds
web-mobile 440, only the waiting chip: it folds
the title keeps 60 % of the bar, not its whole width

menuCases.name: a board: no new issue, no Move to folder (the tree's own)
an agent chat's … without New conversation
